method:
Native 240x160 reboot mockups, not emulator screenshots.

Everything is painted directly at game resolution from literal 4bpp inks.
Nearest-neighbour enlarged copies are for viewing only, never art inputs.
notes: Native object canvases map to padded GBA OBJ shapes in production; no image was downscaled.
Final indexed scene has fewer than 256 colours; source material banks have exactly 16 inks including transparency.
This is a design mockup, not a running game or verified GBA tileset build.
